title: A Wolf in Sheep's Clothing: Targeted Routing Hijacking in Federated RAG
why_relevant: Introduces a novel routing-stage attack on Federated RAG where malicious clients forge semantic profiles, causing missing evidence, poisoning, and hallucinations, and proposes a trust-aware defense. Fits adversarial corruption and retrieval robustness themes.
why_not_or_caveat: Focused on federated RAG setting, which is narrower than mainstream RAG robustness.
